title: Canaanites Reading Hieroglyphs: Horus is Hathor? The Invention of the Alphabet in Sinai
version: Egypt and the Levant 16, 121–160, author-hosted PDF

passages.note: The author compares Egyptian sign models and early alphabetic signs. For consonant ʿayin, she compares the Egyptian eye (D4) with examples from Sinai 352, 375a and 346 and considers other sources for some variants.
